title: 第9章 孩子丢失第10章 内鬼
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第9章孩子丢失
想到这里，男人脸上更是露出疯狂之色。
这个世界对他这么不公平，他凭什么考虑其他人的感受！
他就是要让所有人都跟他一样活在痛苦和仇恨之中！
“诶，三年级的学生来了！”
旁边的胖男人看到自己女儿，赶紧往前走去。
鸭舌帽一听，揣在兜里的手紧了紧，面色阴沉的跟了过去。
在三年一班的孩子走出校门的瞬间，男人掏出兜里的水果刀，双目赤红，快步朝那群孩子冲了过去。
瞬间，尖叫声和哭泣声划破天际……
虽然鸭舌帽男很快被保安和剩下的家长们制服，但仍旧造成了两死五伤的惨状。
丁鹏的大儿子正是五个受伤孩子之一，手臂受伤严重，落下了终身残疾。
林熙收回思绪，面色微微发白。
这不是被预知术里看到的场景吓的，单纯是灵力消耗导致的。
预知术是太玄宗历任掌门才能习得的术法，不仅需要使用之人有着万里挑一的独特天赋，还需要以灵力启动。
林熙这几天好不容易积攒了一点灵力，这下直接消耗了个七七八八。
但想到那七个可怜的孩子，灵力耗了就耗了吧，再修炼就是了。
“大师，到底怎么了！”
丁鹏神色焦急。
林熙没有迟疑，将预知术看到的事情告诉了丁鹏。
一听下午会有一个报复社会的变态杀人狂去小学门口行凶，丁鹏脸瞬间白了。

近些年因为互联网的蓬勃发展，各个地方的社会新闻也都可以第一时间在手机里看到了，有关学校杀人的新闻也偶有看见。
但他们江渝市这边还没有发生过类似的案件，所以像丁鹏这样的学生家长也只会在看到类似新闻的时候感慨几句，新闻报道的那段时间会谨慎一点，但随着时间的推移，家长们也就逐渐放松警惕了。
更何况这种事情其实也没办法时刻提防，毕竟谁也不知道那些心理变态的人会在什么时候动手，说不定上一秒还好好的在路上走着，下一秒就掏出一把刀开始杀人了。
短暂的恐慌之后，丁鹏很快回过神，六神无主的看着林熙。
“大师，那我现在该怎么办？报警吗？”
可现在报警，那人还没有作案不说，拿算命先生算出这件事情的缘由去报案，应该会被教育一顿的吧……
林熙想了想，干脆道：“下午我跟你一起去学校。”
有了林熙这话，丁鹏多少松了一口气，有大师在肯定能一眼辨认出那个男人。
只是看着林熙那瘦弱的小身板，丁鹏觉得自己一拳下去可能她都会哭半天。
所以他暗暗决定一会就联系几个朋友，下午和他一起去学校门口。
两人说好下午联系，丁鹏便神色焦急的回家了。
丁鹏走后，林熙却没有回家，也没有继续等人算命卜卦。
content_en:
Chapter 9 The child is lost
Thinking of this, the man's face showed a look of madness.
The world is so unfair to him, why should he consider other people's feelings?
He just wants everyone to live in pain and hatred like him!
"Hey, the third graders are here!"
The fat man next to him saw his daughter and walked forward quickly.
Upon hearing this, Cap tightened his hands in his pockets and followed him with a gloomy expression.
The moment the children in Class 1, Grade 3 walked out of the school gate, the man took out the fruit knife in his pocket and rushed towards the group of children with red eyes.
In an instant, screams and cries pierced the sky...
Although the man in the peaked hat was quickly subdued by the security guards and the remaining parents, he still caused two deaths and five injuries.
Ding Peng's eldest son was one of the five injured children. His arm was seriously injured and he was left with a lifelong disability.
Lin Xi retracted her thoughts and turned slightly pale.
This was not frightened by the scene he saw in the precognition technique, but simply caused by the consumption of spiritual power.
Precognition is a technique that can only be learned by successive heads of Taixuan Sect. Not only does the person using it need to have a unique talent that is unique to the world, but it also needs to be activated with spiritual power.
Lin Xi had finally accumulated a little spiritual power in the past few days, but now it consumed a lot of it.
But thinking about those seven poor children, just use up your spiritual power and just practice again.
"Master, what's going on!"
Ding Peng looked anxious.
Lin Xi did not hesitate and told Ding Peng what he saw with the precognition technique.
Ding Peng's face instantly turned pale when he heard that a perverted murderer who wanted to take revenge on society would attack in front of the elementary school in the afternoon.
In recent years, due to the booming development of the Internet, social news from various places can be seen on mobile phones for the first time, and news about school killings is also occasionally seen.
But there has never been a similar case in Jiangyu City, so parents of students like Ding Peng will only sigh a few words when they see similar news. They will be more cautious during the period of news reporting, but as time goes by, parents gradually relax their vigilance.
What's more, there is no way to always be on guard against this kind of thing. After all, no one knows when those psychopathic people will take action. They might be walking on the road fine one second, and then take out a knife and start killing people the next second.
After a brief panic, Ding Peng quickly came to his senses and looked at Lin Xi in confusion.
"Master, what should I do now? Call the police?"
But now if you call the police, the person has not committed the crime yet. If you report the case to the fortune teller who calculated the cause of the incident, you should be educated...
Lin Xi thought for a while and simply said: "I will go to school with you in the afternoon."
With Lin Xi's words, Ding Peng breathed a sigh of relief. A master would definitely be able to identify the man at a glance.
Just looking at Lin Xi's thin body, Ding Peng felt that if he punched her, she might cry for a long time.
So he secretly decided to contact a few friends soon and go to the school gate with him in the afternoon.
The two agreed to contact each other in the afternoon, and Ding Peng went home anxiously.
After Ding Peng left, Lin Xi did not go home, nor did she continue to wait for fortune telling.
